ask-matt.description: Router over user-invoked skills in this repo

grill-with-docs.description: Grilling session that builds domain model, CONTEXT.md, and ADRs inline

triage.description: Move issues through a state machine of triage roles

improve-codebase-architecture.description: Scan codebase for deepening opportunities, present as HTML report

setup-matt-pocock-skills.description: Configure repo for engineering skills (tracker, labels, doc layout)

to-spec.description: Turn conversation into a spec, publish to issue tracker. Renamed from /to-prd

to-tickets.description: Break plan/spec/conversation into tracer-bullet tickets with blocking edges. Merged from /to-plan + /to-issues

wayfinder.description: Plan huge work as shared map of investigation tickets on issue tracker

prototype.description: Build throwaway prototype: logic (terminal) or UI (toggleable variations)

diagnosing-bugs.description: Disciplined diagnosis loop: reproduce → minimise → hypothesise → instrument → fix → regression-test

research.description: Investigate question against primary sources, write findings as Markdown, background agent

tdd.description: Red-green-refactor TDD. Reference material only, no step-by-step confirmation

domain-modeling.description: Build and sharpen project domain model, update CONTEXT.md and ADRs

codebase-design.description: Shared discipline for designing deep modules: small interfaces, clean seams

code-review.description: Two-axis review: Standards (coding standards + Fowler smells) and Spec correctness, parallel sub-agents

implement.description: Implement work from spec/tickets. Use TDD at pre-agreed seams. Run type checking regularly

grill-me.description: Get relentlessly interviewed about a plan or design

grilling.description: Interview user relentlessly until every branch of decision tree is resolved

handoff.description: Compact conversation into handoff document for another agent

teach.description: Teach user a new skill over multiple sessions

writing-great-skills.description: Reference for writing and editing skills well

git-guardrails-claude-code.description: Set up hooks to block dangerous git commands

setup-pre-commit.description: Set up Husky pre-commit hooks with lint-staged, Prettier, type checking, tests

ringer_integration.wayfinder_flow: wayfinder (for large plans) → to-spec → to-tickets → implement → code-review
